description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature in a C# ASP.NET Core application, specifically handling user profile updates. It contains the command structure, validation, and handler logic to update user information such as username, email, bio, image, and password.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user profile fields that can be updated by the user.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating the user data to be updated, implementing MediatR's IRequest for asynchronous processing.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring the Command contains a non-null User data object.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the logic for updating the user's profile in the database, including password hashing and mapping to the User envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main method of the Handler class that performs the user update operation, including fetching the current user, updating properties, hashing password if provided, and saving changes.
